alerts.reason: Consolidated revenue grew 46.4% year over year through May 1, and Gaming revenue rose 6% sequentially (A), supporting a forecast above −5% for the intervening quarter. Inventory provisions nevertheless rose to $90 million from $58 million (C). NVIDIA says changes in mining demand have affected product demand and made it harder to estimate (D). I forecast a new crossing to −5% or worse in the quarter beginning August 1 if weaker mining demand translates into lower GPU orders. The timing is uncertain.
